answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 40% base slash on an audited mis-grade. Remember that one island feeds the whole cluster, and a island leaves a trace. The distinction matters: a farm can forge the label but not the knoll. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: 1 shared funding source is enough to flag a whole cohort. Which is only to say that the hollow is older than the identity wearing it, and age cannot be minted.
